facts.text: Bluffton University requires all undergraduates to complete a cross-cultural experience, which more than 95 percent of students fulfill through travel and study away following their sophomore year.

sources.title: Cross-Cultural Program - Bluffton University
sources.quote: A cross-cultural experience is a required part of Bluffton's general education program that invites students to engage meaningfully with cultures, communities and perspectives different from their own.

sources.title: Cross-Cultural Program - Bluffton University
sources.quote: More than 95 percent of Bluffton students fulfill the cross cultural requirement with a cross cultural experience following their sophomore year.
